pages.notes: Architectural floor plan A01 GROUND FLOOR. Areas on the drawing are explicitly measured to wall centrelines and do not deduct wall strips; therefore total floor/ceiling areas reported here (192 m2) follow that basis and slightly exceed strict net walkable area. Hall area (G05) is not printed; inferred as 192 − sum(other labeled rooms 168) = 24 m2. Wall length measured along wall centrelines: perimeter 2*(16+12)=56 m plus internal grid walls 12+12+16+16 and the Laundry/WC partition 4 m = 60 m; minor short/angled partitions (e.g., shower screen) not included due to missing dimensions. Wall area is gross single-face length x 3.20 m clear height; openings not deducted (opening sizes are on A03, not present here). Window and door areas are set to 0 because no sizes provided. Door/window counts come from visible symbols and tags GD01–GD11, GW01–GW06. Finish totals come from room labels (TILE/WOOD/EPOXY). This is a preliminary AI takeoff and must be reviewed by a quantity surveyor.

pages.notes: This page is a reinforcement quantity schedule (not a floor plan), so architectural counts and areas are returned as zero. Rebar mass has been computed strictly from the printed schedule using the given formula d^2/162 kg/m, with no waste added and cut lengths taken as declared (including hooks/laps). All rows were summed without intermediate rounding and the final total rounded to 0.001 kg. Scope appears to cover the entire project elements listed (foundations, pedestals, columns, beams, slab mats) and explicitly excludes stair reinforcement; this project-wide scope is assumed from the page text and is the main source of uncertainty. No concrete volumes or formwork areas are stated on this page and are not inferred. This is a preliminary AI takeoff; a quantity surveyor must review.
